title: Initialization of the capture wrapper
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $D$ be a four-work-tape Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet with a finite state set, and let $x$ be a finite Boolean word. The initial configuration of the output-capture wrapper built from $M$ and $D$ on input $x$ is equal to the first-phase configuration associated with the initial configuration of $M$ on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
$D$ is a four-work-tape Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
replaced:
For every machine $M$, four-tape interpreter $D$, and input $x$, the initial
configuration of the output-capture wrapper of $M$ and $D$ on $x$ coincides
with the first-phase embedding of the initial configuration of $M$ on $x$:
blank table tape, blank interpreter tapes, and empty output.
